evidence.paper_event_name: Line flow redistributes after outages; an inverse-time overload action opens a line, anchored at 1.1 times limit with 5 s delay.
evidence.direct_text_excerpt_short: 线路负载率达到1.1倍承载极限时，过负荷保护延时5s

evidence.paper_event_name: Conventional units use 47.5/51.5 Hz frequency limits with 10 s delay and 0.8/1.3 p.u. voltage limits with 2 s delay.
evidence.direct_text_excerpt_short: 低频保护定值为47.5Hz，过频保护定值为51.5Hz
evidence.time_information_if_explicit: Thresholds and delays are direct text.

evidence.paper_event_name: UFLS is three-stage at 49.0/48.8/48.5 Hz with 0.8/0.5/0.2 s delays and 25/40/55 percent shedding; UVLS is 0.8 p.u., 1 s, 25 percent.
evidence.direct_text_excerpt_short: 设置三段低频减载措施动作定值

evidence.paper_event_name: Temporary-overvoltage protection uses a 1.3 p.u. threshold and opens the related line without intentional delay.
evidence.direct_text_excerpt_short: 过电压阈值为1.3p.u.，在满足动作条件后无延时

evidence.paper_event_name: At 0.50 s a 2 s three-phase fault near bus 29 is followed by wind trip, UFLS, sequential overloaded-line openings, further wind trip, and generator protection.
evidence.direct_text_excerpt_short: 母线29近区发生三相短路故障，故障持续时间2.0s

evidence.paper_event_name: The overload-dominant sequence starts with a short circuit, then overloaded line trip(s), topology degradation, source/load actions, islanding and generator loss.
evidence.direct_text_excerpt_short: 线路L1过载切除，多线路相继切除

evidence.paper_event_name: The off-grid-dominant sequence starts with a short circuit, wind trip and power loss, then state/flow redistribution, line trips, load shedding and generator loss.
evidence.direct_text_excerpt_short: 风机脱网，大量功率损失，电网状态偏移，潮流大幅转移

evidence.paper_event_name: Evaluation uses line-trip count, wind power lost, load shed, and voltage/frequency severity.
evidence.direct_text_excerpt_short: 定义切线数量、风机脱网功率与减载指标

evidence.paper_event_name: UVLS uses a 0.8 p.u. threshold, 1.0 s delay and 25 percent load shedding.
evidence.direct_text_excerpt_short: 低压减载措施电压定值为0.8p.u.

evidence.paper_event_name: The paper models a DFIG wind turbine and uses wind-farm off-grid behavior as the first protection action in an off-grid-dominant chain.
evidence.direct_text_excerpt_short: 风机脱网为主导的连锁故障
